get.description: Get the extra permissions granted directly to a user (on top of their role).

put.description:
Set extra permissions for a user.

Ceiling rule: you cannot grant a permission you don't hold yourself.
Customer users cannot receive extra permissions.
Team admins can only manage users within their own team.

get.description: Get explicit permission denials for a user.

put.description:
Set explicit permission denials for a user (super admin only for customer role).

Ceiling rule: you can only deny permissions that the target user actually has
via their role or team — not arbitrary ones.
Team admins can only deny within their team ceiling.

get.summary: Generate signed QR token for a charger (public)
get.description:
Public endpoint to generate a signed QR token for the HMI on-charger display.

Rate-limited by IP (10 req/min per charger). No auth required.
The returned token can be embedded in a QR code URL. It expires after the configured
TTL (default 24h) and is tamper-proof via HMAC-SHA256.

When token_type is provided, fixed TTLs are applied:
  - session-live → 2 hours
  - raise-ticket → 10 minutes

get.summary: Get a single session by ID
get.description:
Fetch a session from active_sessions or session_history by its ID.
Includes revenue if the charger's price_per_kwh is configured.

Returns SESSION_START / START_CHARGING / STOP_CHARGING / SESSION_STOP events.

Fallback chain when session_events table has no rows:
1. Numeric session_id → query TimescaleDB genone_full_state by session_id field.
2. Time-range → use session start/end timestamps to find state logs for any charger
   type, including those that always report session_id=0 or use UUID session IDs.

Returns state-log telemetry (ExpertPostFullStateData / PostStateData)
stored in TimescaleDB for GenOne chargers.

Use compact=true for the list view; it omits the heavy state data and
returns a short preview instead.  Pass session_id to get only the logs
that belong to a specific charging session.
